cards.question: YouTube Name Checker
cards.qualifier: Check a YouTube handle against the platform's rules, get close valid alternatives, and open youtube.com/@name to see whether a channel already uses it.

cards.name: what-this-youtube-name
cards.title: What this YouTube name checker does

groups.label: Check a list of handles
groups.text: Switch to Check a list to paste up to 200 handles.

groups.label: Reading the channel link
groups.text: The button opens youtube.com/@ followed by your handle in a new tab.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to check YouTube channel name availability

cards.name: key-point
cards.quote: YouTube gives every channel two names, and people looking for a YouTube channel name checker usually mean the handle.
